name: Ruler of the Tower
description: An honor Huanglong presents to those who have achieved tremendous feats in the Tower of Adversity. A testament to their courage, wisdom, and strength.

name: Legend of the Deep
description: In the abyssal dark, you stilled numerous tempests unnamed. Under the beacon you ignited, wandering souls have finally found their way home.

name: Darkness Repeller
description: The countless overwritten records epitomise your tribulations and the limit you have yet reached.

name: Adversity Expeditioner
description: You've reached the boarder of the Tower of Adversity. Truth lines beyond a thin wall.

name: Nightkeeper of Oceans
description: You plummeted to the ocean's abyss, where numerous valiant souls lie silently in their eternal vigil.

name: Overwatcher of Tides
description: The seatides swell to embrace you, in your triumphant return from the beyond.

name: Astral Modulator
description: As the sounds in your memory fall into place, their magnificent echo crosses eons to reach your ears. Throughout your journey, your identity and purposes slowly piece themselves back together, and once again, you, the Astral Modulator, return to the center stage.

name: Lark Among Clouds
description: Wind, though invisible in form, can be seen through the flowers it blows, the flames it caresses, and the larks it makes soar. Wind carries the birdsong high, echoing, echoing... until it is heard once more.

name: Hero Play Hero
description: "The Flame Ranger still chooses to challenge an opponent who is simply unbeatable..." The girl behind the curtain waves a hero figurine in her hand. Whether it was the light or something else, the figurine shone brightly in her grasp.

name: Bloom in Snow
description: A bloom in snow is cold yet irresistibly tempting to touch. But in the end, it cannot escape the natural order of things, and melts away in your hand.

name: Crimson Jadeite
description: A girl who walks among the righteous and the wicked must constantly refine her sense of justice and morality. It is precisely because of this, that the jade pendant hanging from her chest remains so clear and pure.

name: Unhindered Perception
description: "Sit, breathe, and find inner peace." She opens her eyes to perceive the gradual stabilization of frequencies, using pupils corroded by Tacet Discords. She had walked away, free from the blizzard.

name: Leisurely Observer
description: Being half a step slower also meant that Taoqi had more time to observe the world. She gradually began to notice subtle changes in the marketplace. A brick was missing here. A flower had wilted there. The next season would arrive when she was aware.

name: Flaming Intellect
description: Many people light fires they cannot hope to contain. But he is the creator of fire, the master of fire, and the smotherer of fire.

name: Grand Master
description: They say Yuanwu can best any challenger in three minutes. It takes him one minute to step into the ring, then another minute to perform a ceremonial bow, and one final minute before the kettle comes to a boil. "Come now, all martial artists are friends. Do stay for a cup of tea."

name: Market Maker
description: In the market, Aalto floats on the boundary between buying and selling, playing different roles: investor, opportunist, and market mover. He lays chips in every corner. Every investment made is an avenue of future wealth.

name: Whispers Amidst the Blooms
description: Planting seeds, watering and nurturing them till they sprout and bloom... That's how Verina initially imagined what the process of "Healing" meant.

name: Wooly Warrior
description: Encore's paradise is in the land of imagination. Brave Wooly Warriors and their wooly companions leap from the pages of books to a "Happily Ever After."

name: Fangs in Shadow
description: The "hound" in the shadow stalks his prey. First, he is calm, waiting for his target to move through the crowd. Then, unease sets in as the surroundings grow eerily quiet. Finally, the fangs are bared, and the target can no longer see its own shadow.

name: Lion Dancer
description: With every step a dance, he will surely leap to the highest perch.

name: Heart of Clear Mirror
description: With a limpid mind and sustained inner peace, she, who has undergone the trials of the world, completes the final piece of the mirror. The heart is a mirror. The mirror reflects her heart.

name: Loong with the Wind
description: "The enemies surging in were suddenly met by a streak of blue light. Qingloong swept in with the wind, and after the storm subsided, the Midnight Rangers' flag stood tall on the high ground…"

name: Silent Judge
description: Like a puppet with a thousand faces, she walks through the shadows in different facades. But at the end of the day, she's still the one holding the strings.

name: Chrono Thawbringer
description: It was an age when the flow of time was chaotic, with dawn blurring into dusk and the cold proving relentless. Doubt, weariness, and the weight of duty... such was the life of a Magistrate. Though quite young, she shouldered it all as she ascended the mountain, striving to illuminate the sky with a sliver of candlelight. It was the moment when winter relented. The thaw came, and the slopes awoke, bathed in the first tender hues of spring...

name: Eternal Fire
description: Changli wishes for an era of peace and prosperity. This is the longest game of Weiqi she's ever played, and with each move, she becomes a part of the game, an eternal fire that lights the way.

name: Vision of Truth
description: Xiangli Yao often describes himself as a greedy person, who is hungry for truth, yet equally starves for the warmth of human bonds. Though he often gazes at the stars, he occasionally casts glances at the distant mountains and the vast land they anchor. And with each step forward, he measures the distance he has traveled, the life he has lived.

name: Ink Dyed Nature
description: She prefers colors on ink and wash, which, while not the most dazzling, still depict a stunning array of hues. This is Zhezhi's true colors, that which she hopes will one day burst forth with the power to leave others in awe. Or at least, during self-introductions...

name: Stellar Roamer
description: Starlight falls into the deep sea, filling all of her longing and emptiness. In vastness and loneliness, she stood watch over the shores that exist only because of {Male=him;Female=her}... This is her innate duty, both past and future.

name: Keen Conservator
description: Though young, Youhu can already distinguish real antiques from fakes. Valuables weighed down by time can only be cherished and cared for when entrusted to those who understand their value.

name: Camellya Rouge
description: Blossom, wither, and bloom again with memories of the past. When red and white converge... What form will Camellya take when she flowers once more in your eyes?

name: Courier of Dawn
description: We Promise, We Deliver! Bright and cheerful Lumi travels across the vast land of Solaris, delivering messages from distant places to those on her route.

name: Overflowing Opal
description: Before this radiant moment arrived, the "gem" had endured endless nights of rain. Once, she loathed the downpower, but now she embraces the rhythm... With patient hands, she polished the rough stone that was "herself" until it shimmered with a thousand captured hues, in the name of Montelli, and more so in the name of Carlotta.

name: Dancer in the Starlight
description: How should the stage be set for a drama? Spotlights check, curtains check, magnificent costumes? Check. "Pero Pero!" A strange box jumps up and hands her a confetti gun. "Ta-da!" —It's showtime!

name: The Merry Fool
description: Set sail! The curtain rises! This maritime stage belongs to Brant. From the bow comes the scent of "Troupe Strength" and wild laughter mocking the outdated doctrines of The Order. On deck, they're rehearsing plays banned by The Order. From the stern, the sea chases after them in pursuit.

name: Envoy of Light
description: "As the sand of time flickers through your finger, please remember: in the gentle starlight, among beautiful waves, beneath the lantern... and where the kindness of your heart shines, my unspoken words are waiting for you... Listen! The door is open. It's time to move on."

name: Diver of Dreams
description: Where does the dream end and reality begin? The moment your fingers meet the jellyfish, you're falling into a deep sea, descending ever deeper... Only to surface at last into the calm harbor of her gaze.

name: Soloist of Fate
description: Listen! The chimes of a starry, starry night, a prelude to the young maid's song. Bright as midsummer sun even in the depth of the night, yet gentle as the breeze on a summer's day. The wind carries her music across the dark, a melodic story that greets the dawn.

name: Night Aflame
description: A fixed routine isn't that bad. Stability has got to count for something. These are words Zani lives by. Her routine consists of work, meals, sleep, and the occasional bouts of saving the world. Life, after all, is simply a matter of style.

name: Havoc Reaper
description: In the face of darkness, shadow, and fear, courage is your sharpest blade.

name: The Vanguard Gale
description: The wind that sweeps across mountains and seas knows no hesitation, no retreat. As steadfast as an ancient oath and as faithful as a time-forged pact, I am the blade of justice. I am the vanguard that never falters.

name: The Death Defier
description: The Divinity spoke whispers in her ears, she swung her sword in reply. Fate has written her a script, she tore the pages to shreds. She has chosen her own path through gale and tide.

name: Lupus Firestar
description: Flames ignite the cheers of the arena, as the wolf tears out the throats of every shadow. She is the brightest star on the field.

name: Virtual Vanquisher
description: A special reward obtained in "Virtual Crisis: Frontier Trials." It records the highest total Stress Level reached during the challenge.

name: The Nevermore
description: The living dwell upon the dark beyond, stubbornly denying the insurmountable divide between life and death.

name: Eternal Blazing Sun
description: What is the Sun? She is the one who offers warmth and radiance without end. To this ancient land, she devotes her blood, her glory, and her life. And thus, she becomes the Sun, the eternal blaze for all to look upon.

name: Defier of Fated End
description: The Moon has always been herself, long before she knew she was the Moon. She no longer peers into the future through the scattered light of fate, for she understands that wherever she sets her gaze, the future she seeks awaits. Amid the countless paths of destiny, she chooses to become the one true Anchor for herself.

name: Flame Undying
description: I am ash, I am flame; I am darkness, yet I am salvation. Though light falters and torments sear my flesh, still I remain true to my oath. My undying flame shall scour all evil.

name: Blade Within Bamboo
description: A verdant edge cut from bamboo, concealed for the way, unsheathed for the cause.

name: Where the Red Thread Binds
description: Through rain and night, tracing the threads that run through all things, she severs the endless loop, spreads her arms wide, and embraces a summer no longer trapped in stillness.

name: Heeded by Divinities and Demons
description: I grant this Fu Talisman, purging every trace of malice, until my ears hear only clarity, where neither demon nor divinity remains.

name: Colorful Dawn
description: Colors at her fingertips, wind in her ears, and the future in her gaze—her motorbike streaks a bright trail as she rides toward a dawning horizon.

name: Anchor of Ideals
description: Observe. Calculate. Calibrate. Extrapolate… And in the end, she reaches toward the stars.

name: Wings to Spring
description: It began as a dream that took root in a child's heart, then was folded into paper wings and cast upon the spring breeze, flying to the end of the stars. Now, I can finally walk beside you.

name: Golden Diagnosis
description: Under the frozen earth, time rusts like iron. He strips away gold, as if stripping away time itself.

name: Yogurt, Oranges, and Frosting
description: Pour some yogurt into the answer, draw some oranges in the runes, spread some frosting over the future. There is no right or wrong—a perfect balance of sweet and sour.
